notes.title: Share your highscore !
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We hope you enjoy those first hours on Square Arena. Take your time to test the different modes with your firends, or solo (Zombots mode).

Once you start mastering the game, do not hesitate to share us your best scores, especially on the Zombots mode. We will publish the highest scores on Square Arena social media every week :)

Have fun in the Arena !
